title: Matrix product verification criterion
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $A,B,C'$ be $n\times n$ matrices over $\mathbb{F}_2$, and let $x\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$. The equalities $C'x=A(Bx)$ hold in every coordinate if and only if $(C'-AB)x=0$.
